input.quote: 24.1 Customer may assign this Agreement or an Order Form without Vendor's consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of all or substantially all assets or business to which the Agreement relates.
input.rationale: Section 24 meets the preferred position: Customer may assign without consent to an Affiliate or an M&A/asset-sale successor (24.1, notice only); Vendor may not assign, delegate material performance, or transfer by change of control without our consent (not unreasonably withheld) and never to a direct competitor (24.2); other assignments are subject to a mutual reasonable-consent standard (24.3); and our change of control gives Vendor no right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees, or reduce service (24.4). No residual assignment or change-of-control language in § 30 or elsewhere cuts back these rights. No redline needed.
